## Stack and review base

Slice 1 of 5. This foundation targets upstream `main`; HiCache enablement and linker contracts are independent children. No new Dynamo PR is part of this publication.

Exact incremental diff: https://github.com/ziqifan617/sglang/compare/eb4b167d2749840eae18167fe9e0a608308e45aa...e17419bd4a3e8d6783202359fe6eab1ad41d2183

## Motivation

Provide the small endpoint contract shared by the HiCacheStorage and direct-device KVCR integrations, without coupling their different memory layouts or adding a mandatory KVCR dependency.

## Modifications

- Add validated rank-local TCP endpoint parsing and offsets, including inverse offsets, IPv6 and port-range checks.
- Require homogeneous source topology when applying rank offsets.
- Reuse existing typed request-hint plumbing; this does not establish a source lease or cache residency.
- Add four CPU contract cases, including optional-dependency-safe import coverage.

## Accuracy Tests

Recorded exact-source validation: all four endpoint contract cases pass. This utility-only slice does not change model computation or claim GPU/transport validation.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable to this utility-only slice; downstream model results belong to their exact leaf revisions.

## Review status

Draft for API/scope review. The source was prepared on upstream `eb4b167d2749840eae18167fe9e0a608308e45aa`; a fresh merge-tree check against upstream `a3d00eff58b6c22ea7539f882cc10c537634200b` was clean. This is not an upstream CI pass.

Existing SGLang #43635 remains unchanged. No new Dynamo PR is proposed; companion work remains ai-dynamo/dynamo#16117 and ai-dynamo/dynamo#16827.

## Checklist

- [x] Add focused unit tests.
- [x] Scoped formatting checks recorded on the prepared source.
- [ ] Upstream review and CI.

```text
Shared foundation #45646

│   └── HiCache performance #45649
└── Linker contracts #45648
    └── Direct linker #45650
```

- Foundation: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45646
- HiCache storage: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45647
- HiCache performance: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45649
- Linker contracts: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45648
- Direct linker: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45650
- KVCR optional SDK tuning: https://github.com/ai-dynamo/kvcr/pull/113
- KVCR SGLang quick-start preview: https://github.com/ai-dynamo/kvcr/pull/114

detail.title: [KVCR 1/5] Share rank-local endpoint contracts

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Optional KVCR integration primitives; importing this package does not load KVCR."""

@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Rank-local control endpoints shared by KVCR storage and direct delivery.
+
+Only callers with an explicitly homogeneous source topology may apply a rank
+offset. A router hint is advisory; endpoint validation does not establish a
+source lease or prove that a transfer completed.
+"""
+
+from urllib.parse import urlsplit
+
+
+def rank_offset(config) -> int:
+    """TP is the innermost rank within one advertised DP replica."""
+    return config.tp_rank + config.tp_size * (
+        config.attn_cp_rank + config.attn_cp_size * config.pp_rank
+    )
+
+
+def rank_endpoint(endpoint: str, offset: int) -> str | None:
+    """Offset an advertised TCP endpoint, or reject an ambiguous address."""
+    if not isinstance(endpoint, str) or type(offset) is not int:
+        return None
+    try:
+        source = urlsplit(endpoint)
+        port = source.port
+        if (
+            source.scheme != "tcp"
+            or not source.hostname
+            or port is None
+            or not 1 <= port <= 65535
+            or not 1 <= port + offset <= 65535
+            or source.path
+            or source.query
+            or source.fragment
+            or source.username is not None
+        ):
+            return None
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    host = source.hostname
+    if ":" in host:
+        host = f"[{host}]"
+    return f"tcp://{host}:{port + offset}"

@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+"""One source replica's rank ports must not cross endpoint or topology bounds."""
+
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.storage.kvcr import endpoints
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.storage.kvcr.endpoints import rank_endpoint, rank_offset
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=1, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestKVCRRankEndpoints(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_shard_offsets_are_unique_within_one_replica(self):
+        config = SimpleNamespace(tp_size=4, attn_cp_size=2)
+        offsets = []
+        for pp in range(2):
+            config.pp_rank = pp
+            for cp in range(2):
+                config.attn_cp_rank = cp
+                for tp in range(4):
+                    config.tp_rank = tp
+                    offsets.append(rank_offset(config))
+        self.assertEqual(offsets, list(range(16)))
+        self.assertEqual(
+            rank_endpoint("tcp://source.example:32100", offsets[-1]),
+            "tcp://source.example:32115",
+        )
+
+    def test_ipv6_host_and_zero_offset_remain_unambiguous(self):
+        for source, offset, expected in (
+            ("tcp://127.0.0.1:32100", 0, "tcp://127.0.0.1:32100"),
+            ("tcp://source.example:32100", 2, "tcp://source.example:32102"),
+            ("tcp://source.example:32102", -2, "tcp://source.example:32100"),
+            ("tcp://[2001:db8::1]:32100", 2, "tcp://[2001:db8::1]:32102"),
+            ("tcp://source.example:65535", 0, "tcp://source.example:65535"),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(source=source, offset=offset):
+                self.assertEqual(rank_endpoint(source, offset), expected)
+
+    def test_invalid_addresses_cannot_select_another_source(self):
+        for source in (
+            "http://source.example:32100",
+            "tcp://source.example",
+            "tcp://source.example:bad",
+            "tcp://source.example:0",
+            "tcp://source.example:65536",
+            "tcp://source.example:32100/path",
+            "tcp://source.example:32100?query",
+            "tcp://source.example:32100#fragment",
+            "tcp://user:password@source.example:32100",
+            "tcp://[2001:db8::1:32100",
+            "tcp://:32100",
+            None,
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(source=source):
+                self.assertIsNone(rank_endpoint(source, 1))
+        self.assertIsNone(rank_endpoint("tcp://source.example:65535", 1))
+        self.assertIsNone(rank_endpoint("tcp://source.example:1", -1))
+        for offset in (True, 0.5, "1"):
+            with self.subTest(offset=offset):
+                self.assertIsNone(rank_endpoint("tcp://source.example:32100", offset))
+
+    def test_shared_helpers_do_not_import_the_optional_runtime(self):
+        result = subprocess.run(
+            [
+                sys.executable,
+                "-c",
+                "import runpy,sys; sys.modules['kvcr']=None; "
+                "runpy.run_path(sys.argv[1])",
+                endpoints.__file__,
+            ],
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            timeout=10,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
